name: Chip
purpose: Represents a compact selectable label for filters, categories, or short choices.
neverUseFor: Primary page actions — use Button instead
Long text labels — chips are compact by design
Destructive confirmation flows — use a Button pair instead
rationale: Chip uses a local density model (s 24px / m 32px) instead of the control ladder so a Chip s sits exactly 4px inside a 32px field like MultiSelect (ADR-019). Its off-scale 6px icon gap is split into 4px + 2px scale tokens, and it renders as a real button so Enter/Space activation is native.

mayExtendLocally: Choose the label, icon and dismiss behavior per usage
Wire selection or removal to product state
mustEscalateToDS: New chip sizes or changes to the 24/32px heights
New color variants or overriding spacing tokens
Using Chip for primary actions or destructive confirmations

authored.name: dismissible
authored.description: Renders an additional close button (chip-dismiss) beside the chip, active only when both dismissible=true and onDismiss is provided.

anatomy.description: The pill: fill, 1px border, radius, height and the 12px padding on both ends — the same whatever it contains. Holds the chip button and, when dismissible, the dismiss button, both in normal flow.
Transparent button holding the icons and label; its ::after stretches over the whole pill so the full chip is clickable.

Close button after chip-icon-end, in the row: 2px on the label side (spacing-3xs) + the 12px ×. Its round hover (20px s / 24px m) is a pseudo-element that takes no space. Rendered only when dismissible=true and onDismiss is provided.

props.name: size
props.description: Horizontal density preset. Chip is a documented exception to the global scale — default is 's', not 'm', a deliberate deviation from ADR-004's general 'm is the default' convention for this component specifically.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, passed by reference. Rendered via the Icon component at a fixed 14px.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Trailing icon. Same fixed 14px as icon.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close button for removing the chip.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Dismiss handler fired from the close button.

height.note: Chip uses a local density model; this does not redefine the global scale. s = 24px (semantic.size.s, was 28px until 2026-10-01): same height as Badge s and the control ladder's s, and it sits 4px inside a 32px field (MultiSelect, ADR-019).

modes.hug: Width shrinks to fit label and icons.
modes.fixed: Explicit width set by the consumer.

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: state
properties.description: Figma-only axis: CSS pseudo-classes. disabled / isLoading are their own false/true toggles (contracts/figma-conversion.json,  pattern action).

properties.name: dismissible
properties.description: Show/hide part (show-hide-parts.md): toggles the chip-dismiss layer. The × carries its own 2px on the label side; the chip keeps 12px on both ends either way.

figma.variantCombinations: 50 variants (2026-10-21): variant × size × state = 40,  disabled per variant × size = 10. Disabled keeps the variant colors at 0.72 opacity,  like code.

KeyboardActivation.reason: keyboard focus — the focus ring is drawn in Figma (owner 2026-10-21: focus states are drawn)
